- (2) Legitimate children and stepchildren, residing with and wholly dependent. Children includes major sons, legally adopted children and widowed daughters, residing with and wholly dependent. Restricted to two children with effect from 1st January, 1999. However, this restriction does not apply to existing employees with more than two children including those born up to 31-12-1998. Does not apply also to employees with no/ one child on 31-12-1998 but next confinement resulting in multiple births thereby
